duration.text: The Chinese Language at Zhejiang University of Science and Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) Application form (Applicants must be done in the application system :( http://isam.zust.edu.cn)2) Scanned copy of passport, scanned copies of all visa pages in China;3) Applicant should be foreign citizens. Foreign citizens of Chinese origin who are now applying to study in China as international students must have held a valid foreign passport for at least 4 years, and must have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30, the enrollment year) (9 months of residence in a foreign country may count as a full year).4) Scanned copy of the notarized high school graduation certificate (in Chinese or English); If the original certificate is not in English or Chinese, a notarized translation version is also required. Fresh high school graduates shall be issued a pre-graduation certificate by their school, and the high school graduation certificate must be submitted when students register;5) Notarized transcripts including all courses in high school (in Chinese or English); If the original transcript is not in English or Chinese, a notarized translation version is also required.6) Students applying for English-taught bachelor programs and whose native language is not English are required to provide proof of English proficiency, such as IELTS, TOEFL or other English proficiency certificates, or pass the entrance English test of Zhejiang University of Science and Technology);7) Students applying for Chinese-taught bachelor programs are required to provide proof of Chinese proficiency for programs of science, engineering, economics, management, and art applicants should have acquired the Chinese proficiency of HSK Level 4≥180; for programs of literature and education applicants should have acquired the Chinese proficiency of HSK Level 4≥195);8) Certificate of No Criminal Record; A statement of no drug addiction history;9) Transfer letter with attendance rate for those who already study in China;10) Application fee payment voucher (RMB 400 or USD 60);11) Transfer letter with class attendance for students who have been or are studying in other universities in China;12) Statement of Financial Support (Bank statement to prove that the applicant has sufficient fund to afford his or her tuition, accommodation and living expenses in China);13) Valid Foreigner Physical Examination Report.

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passports.High school education or above.Physical condition: In good health, meets the health examination standards of applying for a student visa or residence permit in China.Other requirements: Good moral character and no criminal record; Willing to abide by the laws, regulations, and relevant school rules; Provide a commitment of no drug use or involvement.
